learning_outcomes.text: Ability to understand how to provide motivation in teamwork.
Ability to offer solution strategies for different problems that may be encountered at the individual, group, and organizational levels in work environments.
Ability to learn the necessary knowledge and skills to conduct research on organizational behavior in different work environments.
Ability to possess the necessary theoretical and applied knowledge on topics such as job analysis, evaluating, selecting, and training employees.
Ability to learn the theories and principles underlying organizational behavior in different organizations and industries.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to Industrial Psychology and Organizational Ethics
bibliography: Aamodt,M.G.(2007) Industrial/Organizational Psychology; An Applied Approach (5th ed.), ThomsonWadsworth, USA
institution: Düzce University — Elektrik-Elektronik Mühendisliği (Electrical-Electronics Engineering), Normal Öğretim
